findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "spellbook_commander_case_comparison" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read exact Commander case membership and USD market-price references for an equivalent set of individual decks. Use it to compare a named case with its required child quantities. Resolve the numeric case product with spellbook_sealed_product_search first. Returns source-linked recipe counts, case an" → after: "Read exact Commander case or deck display membership and USD market-price references for an equivalent set of individual decks. A product named Case or Display, such as Bloomburrow Commander Deck Display, qualifies. Use it to compare that package with its required child quantities. Resolve the numer"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
